a.xlink:title: Central identity — customers, vendors, employees. Has related Email, Phone, Address models. Model: apps/contacts/models/contact.py

Sales proposal — forecast. on_p tracks weighted probability. Model: apps/transactions/models/proposal.py Functions: transfer_proposal_to_order @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:219 (converts proposal to order) Pending deltas: on_p: +qty_x_prob

Sales order — customer commitment. Creates +on_so and -on_p pending records. Model: apps/transactions/models/order.py Functions: transfer_proposal_to_order @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:219 (creates order from proposal) _create_transfer_pending_records @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:131 (pending records for +on_so, -on_p) Pending deltas: on_so: +qty, on_p: -qty

Invoice — shipment event. Financial event triggers GL and inventory movement. Model: apps/transactions/models/invoice.py Functions: transfer_order_to_invoice @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_invoice.py:16 (creates invoice from order) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_invoice.py:332 (-on_hand, -on_so, +on_in) Pending deltas: on_hand: -qty, on_so: -qty, on_in: +qty GL: AR debit, Revenue credit, Tax credit, COGS debit, Inventory credit, Commission

Payment — handles AR (received) and AP (expense). Signed amounts. Category maps to GL. Statement Sorter feeds expense side. Model: apps/transactions/models/payment.py Functions: Payment @ apps/transactions/models/payment.py:1 (AR+AP via type field; signed amounts)

Work order completion — production items enter inventory. Model: apps/transactions/models/workorder.py Functions: complete_workorder @ apps/transactions/services/flow.py:361 (WO completion) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/flow.py:452 (+on_hand, -on_wo) Pending deltas: on_hand: +qty, on_wo: -qty

Product with quantity JSON tracking all inventory buckets. Model: apps/products/models/item.py:196 Functions: Item.quantity @ apps/products/models/item.py:238 (JSONField with on_hand, allocated, available, on_p, on_so, on_in, on_po, on_wo, on_r)
